title: cdk-construct-iam-policy + iam-role + iam-user examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples for all three IAM constructs together (they compose naturally).

packages/cdk-construct-iam-policy/examples/:
- minimal/ — empty policy (no statements)
- with-statements/ — policyStatements map
- from-json/ — sourceJsonUrl / sourcePolicyDocuments

packages/cdk-construct-iam-role/examples/:
- minimal/ — roleDescription + service principal
- comprehensive/ — multiple principals, managed policies, inline policies, instance profile
- with-instance-profile/ — instanceProfileEnabled:true (divergent: adds instance profile resource)
- cross-account/ — assumeRoleConditions with external account

packages/cdk-construct-iam-user/examples/:
- minimal/ — userName only
- with-login-profile/ — loginProfileEnabled:true (divergent: adds console access)
- with-groups/ — group membership

All 5 languages each. Assertion tests in each packages test/ dir.

comments.author: lead-engineer
comments.body: PR #97 open: iam examples under review
